items.answer: The integral of 6x is 3x^2 + C. The +C is needed because every function 3x^2 + C, for any constant C, differentiates back to 6x.
items.prompt: Find the indefinite integral of 6x and explain why your answer must include +C.

items.answer: Never drop the +C: differentiating x^2 + 5 and x^2 + 7 both give 2x.
